title: Claude for Legal
summary: Claude for Legal is an official Anthropics project providing guidance, prompts, and examples for leveraging Claude AI in legal workflows, including contract analysis, document review, and legal research tasks.
problem_solved: Helps legal professionals and developers integrate Claude AI capabilities into legal document processing, contract review, and compliance workflows.
why_valuable: Provides authoritative, vetted approaches from Anthropics for applying LLMs to time-consuming legal tasks, reducing manual review effort while maintaining accuracy.
